title: Distinct auxiliary leaf rectangles are disjoint
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic communication protocol over input types $X$ (Alice) and $Y$ (Bob) producing values of type $\alpha$, and let $A \subseteq X$ and $B \subseteq Y$. If $R$ and $S$ are two distinct rectangles in the collection of auxiliary leaf rectangles of $p$ relative to $A$ and $B$, then $R$ and $S$ are disjoint as subsets of $X \times Y$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a deterministic communication protocol over X, Y with values in α
A is a subset of X
B is a subset of Y
R belongs to the auxiliary leaf rectangles of p relative to A and B
S belongs to the auxiliary leaf rectangles of p relative to A and B
replaced:
If $R, S \in \texttt{leafRectanglesAux}(p, A, B)$ and $R \neq S$, then $R$ and $S$ are
disjoint subsets of $X \times Y$.
